$comment: Account-level blocklist for the retired datapack programme. Enforced by scripts/datapack_guard.py in pre-commit, pre-push and CI, and mirrored org-wide by vortaforge/.github. Read blocklist/README.md before editing. Every entry needs: id, reason, added_on, added_by, enforcement.

managed.$comment: Accounts listed here are never matched by broad rules (bot/AI/profile heuristics). Add the maintainer's own bots here, not in `blocked`.

policy.$comment: profile_scan is only executed by the org sync workflow (.github/scripts/blocklist_sync.py) with a read-only token: it reads public GitHub profile bio/company/name fields, never private data. It auto-files a blocked-account issue or adds the account to the generated org blocklist; accounts the maintainer wants exempt must be listed in managed.accounts.

blocked.reason: Datapack developer/tooling author (misode, misode.dev). Maintainer decision 2026-11-05: datapack developers are blocked from the organisation after the datapack programme was retired.
blocked.notes: Exact account/org handles only - no wildcard globbing (a pattern like misode* would also catch unrelated accounts).

blocked.reason: Accounts that authored the packs now in archived/packs/. Blocked as datapack developers per the maintainer's retirement decision; this is a policy decision, not an accusation.
blocked.notes: If one of these accounts is to keep contributing to mods/ (not datapacks), move the login to managed.accounts instead of deleting the entry, so the exemption is explicit.

blocked.reason: Automation and bot accounts must not author datapack content or reviews.
blocked.notes: Matches logins ending in [bot], -bot, _bot or .bot. Managed bots (managed.accounts) are exempt.

blocked.reason: AI agent and AI-assistant accounts are blocked from authoring this repository; historical commits by them are kept but not repeated.
blocked.notes: match_ai_accounts heuristics: login contains copilot/claude/chatgpt/openai/gemini/grok/codex/anthropic, or an ai/agent/automation/devlop token between separators.

blocked.reason: Datapack developers are blocked organisation-wide. Detected by reading the public profile fields declared in policy.profile_tokens; a human still confirms each hit before the login is added to `blocked`.
blocked.notes: Fail-closed for pull requests: until a hit is confirmed or exempted the account is refused (guard rule pr-blocked).
